client: confidential

start: 2022-01
end: 2022-03
engagement: hourly
stack:

  steps.

text: Mina was easy to work with and took feedback well throughout the project. When we asked for changes to the retention views and onboarding funnel, she adjusted quickly and kept the work moving without a lot of back-and-forth. The monthly retention curves by signup cohort and plan were clear, and the analysis surfaced one onboarding step tied to 40% of first-month churn. Would hire again for this kind of work.
